name: The Pavilion
overview: **The Pavilion** is a mockumentary comedy about Emilio, who takes over his father’s riverside ranch and event venue, High View at the Brazos River, and tries to prove he can run it successfully. Surrounded by a team of incompetent employees and constantly checked by his father’s assistant Greg, Emilio struggles to keep the business alive while dealing with a divorce and trying to bring in new customers. Things get even more chaotic with a sarcastic talking dog only he can hear, adding to the madness as Emilio tries to hold everything together.
